GRINCH GIFT CHAOS – LEFT RIGHT CHRISTMAS GAME

Bring hilarious holiday chaos to your Christmas celebration with this printable Grinch Left Right Christmas Game! This fun Pass the Present gift exchange story features a mischievous Grinch, festive illustrations, and plenty of unexpected LEFT and RIGHT moments.

Whether you're planning a family Christmas gathering, office holiday party, Friendsmas celebration, or festive group activity, this printable Christmas party game is easy to set up and fun to play.

WHAT'S INCLUDED

You will receive 3 ready-to-print PDF files:

PDF 1: A4 Size – 1 complete game per page

PDF 2: US Letter Size (8.5 × 11 inches) – 1 complete game per page

PDF 3: US Letter Landscape – 2 games per page to save paper and printing costs

All three versions feature the same Grinch Gift Chaos Christmas story, so you can choose the printing format that suits your needs.

HOW TO PLAY

1. Gather everyone in a circle with one wrapped gift.
2. Choose one person to read the story aloud.
3. Whenever the reader says LEFT, pass the present to the left.
4. Whenever the reader says RIGHT, pass the present to the right.
5. Keep passing as the story unfolds.
6. Whoever is holding the present when the story ends wins!
